notes.title: Brand new prologue!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Racers![/h1]
[h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37798529/32831f273058e78051f2c1b76b9d28ae6ed2563b.jpg[/img]
[i]Photo-mode screenshot[/i]

In this "Big Update" I prepare:

- Brand new prologue structure! With a part of a story mode. Cutscenes, boss fight, and two different cities! 

- New "Podium to Win" career mode - now you can unlock new tracks when you are on the podium (win on 1, 2, or 3 race position)

- driftmode balance - you can use handbrake to initialize slide,
- fixed steering input bugs - now steering will be much smoother,
- car handling fixes - faster and better steering cars,
- smoother screenshake - now is lighter and shouldn't drop fps,

- lot of Hud fixes,
- Varna and Warsaw tracks fixes - now you have walls on few dangerous corners,
- Tutorial on new fastest Varna autodrome, not used in story mode,
- AI cars have better paths and speed balance,
- Added special Photo-Mode - now you can pause the game and catch the best moments of your races on photo

The full game is still growing and I'm keeping it updated, now it's the 20th update.
[/h3] https://store.steampowered.com/app/696150
[h3]I hope you'll like it. Please leave a review to help other players to find this game.[/h3]

To be a part of the Electro Ride Community please join our Discord:
[url=https://discord.gg/5ftEyBN4bv]https://discord.gg/5ftEyBN4bv[/url]

See you on the road,
Electro Ride Team

notes.title: Changelog #4
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Racers!
29 years ago the last Fiat 125p left Polish FSO manufacture in Warsaw...
And we are working hard to make Electro Ride as good as possible.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37798529/02ea8d8108108cd9e22f3cf6ca0e96097273abfd.jpg[/img]

(This is my '89 Fiat 125p)

[h2]
What's new:

- Fixed Steering smooth,
- Rebalance handling in few cars,
- Fixed position counter in Last Man Stand type races,
- Car bumpers and road walls should has less fricrion,
- Handbrake is more sentive,
- AI should be more careful.[/h2]

See you on the road,
Electro Ride Team

notes.title: Changelog #3
notes.content:

- Tracks optimisation,
- Unactive collectible stars are now more transparend,
- Increesed cars handling,

See you on the road,
Electro Ride Team

notes.title: Changelog #2
notes.content:
Hello, Racers!

We getting closer and closer to full release, but still, there is some work to do.

We are very thankful for all reviews and ideas on how we can make Electro Ride better. We are happy to say that, we've made some changes already:

- incrised steering sensitivity
- steering smooth you can off/on in settings 
- little gameplay fixes and optimisation on Berlin tracks
- little fixes in Main menu and Settings
- fixed finish line bug

It's starting to be heat here, so thanks for taking your part!

See you soon,
Electro Ride Team
